about_blocks.text: Pathways is a non-profit organization that helps people struggling with substance use disorders. The organization is registered as a charity with the Canada Revenue Agency and is regulated by guidelines maintained by the British Columbia Ministry of Health. Pathways offers a range of outpatient services to over 1000 clients each year, including individual counseling, group therapy, and education sessions. They also offer services for people whose lives have been affected by someone else’s substance use. In this article, we will provide an overview of Pathways and its services.

about_blocks.text: Pathways provides a range of outpatient services to help people with substance use disorders. These services include individual counseling, group therapy, and education sessions. They also offer services for people whose lives have been affected by someone else’s substance use. Pathways recognizes that each person’s journey is unique, and they tailor their services to meet the individual needs of their clients. They are committed to providing services that are evidence-based and grounded in harm reduction principles.

Pathways also offers NEW online courses, which provide flexible support that can be accessed from anywhere at any time.

about_blocks.text: Pathways – Addiction Resource Centre is a not-for-profit society located in British Columbia, Canada. The center focuses on assisting individuals struggling with substance use and addiction issues to connect with themselves, their families and their community through counseling, education and referrals. Pathways offers specialized counseling services for youth through seniors, parents whose children are dealing with substance abuse as well as anyone needing guidance in overcoming addiction.
about_blocks.html: Pathways – Addiction Resource Centre is a not-for-profit society located in British Columbia, Canada. The center focuses on assisting individuals struggling with substance use and addiction issues to connect with themselves, their families and their community through counseling, education and referrals. Pathways offers specialized counseling services for youth through seniors, parents whose children are dealing with substance abuse as well as anyone needing guidance in overcoming addiction.

about_blocks.text: At Pathways, individuals can receive evidence-based practices, holistic therapy, and nutritional counseling to address their personal struggles. They can also participate in yoga and meditation, art and nature therapy, individual, family and group therapy and counseling. Through its state-of-the-art services, Pathways aims to help individuals overcome addiction, recover and lead a healthy and happier life. The centre receives its primary funding from the Interior Health Authority of British Columbia while abiding by guidelines issued by the British Columbia Ministry of Health.
